concepts.name: editorial-focus
concepts.title: 01 / EDITORIAL FOCUS
concepts.generationPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one polished concept presentation board, raster preview of an original vector-friendly brand identity for Distil, a personal AI-powered reading and knowledge app. Personality: modern editorial intelligence, calm, curious, precise, warm. Inspiration: contemporary book typography meeting optical precision.
Presentation: landscape 1536x1024. Flat warm ivory #F6F3ED canvas. Generous margins and disciplined Swiss editorial grid. Ink #172329 and electric cobalt #315DF5 only, with white for reversed variants. No textures, photography, shadows, embossing, gradients, glow, 3D, decorative illustrations, brains, neural networks, sparkles, funnels, chemistry glassware or existing brand marks.
Layout: small concept number and title at top left, quiet horizontal rule. Main horizontal logo is large and optically centered in upper-middle 55 percent, with extraordinary letterform quality and generous clear space. Bottom third separated by fine horizontal rule has three equal specimen cells: ink symbol on ivory; ivory symbol on dark ink rounded-square app tile; cobalt symbol on ivory alongside a small full logo. Same exact symbol geometry in every specimen, only color and scale change. Bottom labels only: "MONO", "DARK", "SMALL". Tiny specimen must still be a substantial legible shape. Keep the board simple, a logo study rather than a full website.
Wordmark exact spelling: "distil", lowercase d-i-s-t-i-l, SIX letters. Original, expertly kerned contemporary editorial serif, moderate stroke contrast, sturdy enough for a digital interface, clean cut terminals and subtly geometric counters. No tagline. Only other allowed text is the title specified below and the three specimen labels.
Top-left title verbatim: "01 / EDITORIAL FOCUS".
Design direction: create a truly distinctive lowercase d monogram as a standalone symbol to the left of the ink wordmark "distil". The symbol should feel like a sculpted contemporary publisher's mark, a confident near-circular bowl with a tall precise ascender. Warm human exterior curvature, perfectly clear generous geometric counter. ONE precise diagonal interruption or cut in the bowl is its distinctive optical signature, suggesting focus and an idea becoming clear. The cut must be bold and intentional, not a hairline. Make the d recognizably lowercase and avoid looking like a power button or music note. Hero symbol is cobalt and wordmark ink. Aim for iconic and restrained, with no extra interior dots or decorative elements. The main wordmark and symbol should feel related but not simply duplicate a standard font d.
